office: the Civil Registry and Passport Office, Road Town, which takes applications for United Kingdom passports

routes.label: through the Civil Registry and Passport Office

note: The Civil Registry and Passport Office's fees for United Kingdom passports from 8 April 2026, each with the delivery fee of £14.32 that Virgin Islands News Online reports is applied to all transactions: £116.50 for an adult, £75.50 for a child, £130.50 and £89.50 for the frequent traveller passport. The age bands, the 54 pages of the frequent traveller passport and the validity are the United Kingdom passport's, as GOV.UK gives them. The processing time is a lead.

sources.title: Government of the Virgin Islands, Civil Registry & Passport Office, Increased Fees for United Kingdom Passports (press release, 22 April 2026)
sources.said: The Civil Registry and Passport Office advises the public of an increase in fees for United Kingdom passports effective 8th April, 2026. The new fee structure is as follows: New/Renewal/Replacement Adult Passport: £116.50 New/Renewal/Replacement Child Passport: £75.50 Adult Passport (Frequent Traveller): £130.50 Child Passport (Frequent Traveller): £89.50 Change to Passport: £116.50 Delivery Fee: £14.32

sources.title: Virgin Islands News Online, Civil Registry & Passport Office announces increase in UK passport fees (April 2026)
sources.said: A delivery fee of £14.32 will be applied to all transactions.

sources.title: GOV.UK, Passport fees
sources.said: Adult (16 and over) standard 34-page passport ... Adult (16 and over) 54-page frequent traveller passport ... Child (under 16) standard 34-page

sources.title: GOV.UK, Apply for your first adult passport
sources.said: An adult passport is valid for 10 years.

sources.title: GOV.UK, Get a passport for your child
sources.said: A child passport is valid for 5 years.
